identifyTitle: How would you like to identify yourself?
identifySubtitle: Choose an option and enter the data to locate your stay.

genericLookupBody: We could not complete the lookup right now. Please try again or go to reception.
confirmationSubtitle: Review the booking details before facial verification.
reservationEligible: This reservation is ready to continue.
reservationNotEligible: This reservation still requires reception validation.

identitySubtitle: Capture your document, confirm your face, and accept the required terms to continue.
identityDocumentInstruction: Place the document inside the frame and keep the CPF and name visible.
identitySelfieInstruction: Look at the camera with your face centered and uncovered.
identityApprovedBody: The document and selfie were validated. Accept the terms to continue.
identityFallbackBody: The document matches the reservation. Biometric verification will continue in document-only review mode.
identityTermsConsent: I accept the stay terms, privacy policy, and hotel rules.
identityBiometricConsent: I authorize biometric validation for this check-in.
